report_discrepancies.note: Exhibit B (p2) prints Capital projects 11,436,387.39 and Other student support 503,561.10; Exhibit D (p6) prints 11,468,688.94 and 471,259.55. The 32,301.55 is classed in different functions; total disbursements 19,078,661.38 agree. JSON follows Exhibit D.

notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds are governmental (School Nutrition and Activities are in the governmental funds), so business_type is null. Receipts/disbursements are from the Total Governmental Funds column (Exhibit D, spans pp5-6; labels p5, amounts p6), after the Reclassifications column which nets the 42,459.06 General-to-Other-funds transfer to zero, so transfers are null at top level. Beginning cash = beginning fund balance/net position 19,459,092.11 (p6); ending 8,983,358.03 ties to Exhibit A (p1). Identity reconciles. Balance sheet = Statement of Net Position (p1), cash only, no liabilities. 'Other student support' 471,259.55 split into Activities (227,794.90, p14) and School Nutrition (243,464.65, p15) disbursements, which sum to it; 'Debt service' split into principal and interest+fees from Bond Fund schedule p16. Detail: General Fund receipts from budget schedule Exhibit G (pp9-10); General Fund spending uses Exhibit N object detail (pp18-24, complete after the v7 re-trim added pp20-24; its Total Cash Disbursements 6,709,256.67 on p24, incl. the 42,459.06 transfer, ties to the budget schedule total); the earlier 'not itemized' budget-schedule lines for programs 2171 onward were replaced by the Exhibit N object lines (Exhibit N prints no budgets, so budget_final is null; program totals match Exhibit G). Exhibit F (General Fund components, pp7-8) not recorded in detail to avoid double counting. Hidden transfers: Exhibit F reclassification column (p8) shows 309,691.00 of General Fund spending (133,091 regular instruction, 41,000 operation/maintenance, 135,600 regular transportation) is really the transfer to the Depreciation Fund (receipt on p12); recorded as contra lines plus an other financing item. The 8000 Transfers 42,459.06 is an other financing item; the receiving side is inside Activities Fund receipts (374,732.64 = 332,273.58 + 42,459.06 derived from Other Governmental Funds receipts 583,045.13 = 374,732.64 + 208,312.49), recorded as contra line plus other financing. Exhibit G regular instruction etc. differ from Exhibit F by 350 (3300 Community service shown inside Regular instruction on p7). Per-line budgets not printed for Exhibit N, Activities and fund schedules other than totals. Zero ('-') lines not recorded. The General Fund budget schedule's expenditure total (p11) now ties with includes_schedules = Exhibit N (Exhibit N lines + hidden-transfer contra lines + the two transfers out).
